About Pro Fer Forgé

Your wrought-iron specialist in Montréal

Pro Fer Forgé specializes in wrought iron painting, restoration and welding in Montréal and the surrounding area. For several years we have supported condo associations, co-ops and building owners in maintaining and restoring their structures, ensuring safety, compliance and durability.

We work on balconies, stairs, railings and other metal structures through a complete service of wrought iron painting and wrought iron restoration and welding in Montréal.

Clean work, professional methods and lasting results.

Our method

  1. Inspection and diagnosis of your installations
  2. Preparation adapted to each structure
  3. Careful work, welding and painting included
  4. Lasting protection against corrosion

Our commitments

  • Careful, durable work
  • Deadlines respected
  • Client satisfaction

A reliable service for your wrought-iron structures
